messages:
sara: Quick postmortem follow-up from the late-night regression — recurring tail spikes + temporary throughput collapse under bursty request patterns. Need clear action owners for the next 10 days.
tony: Thanks — I can take the short-term mitigation (adaptive batcher + rate-limiter knob). Aim to ship a low-risk toggle by Fri.
sara: Prefer we separate: (A) immediate mitigation (toggle + throttle), (B) diagnostics & dashboards, (C) SLA/comms plan.
lei: I'll own diagnostics/dashboards. Plan: add a burst-sensitivity panel, error-budget runway graph, and per-backend p99.99. Will also add an annotation layer for incident windows.
rob: I'll coordinate SLA wording with product/security and draft a customer-facing note if we hit prolonged degradation.
tony: Mitigation detail (draft config in staging): ```yaml
adaptive_batcher:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_ms: 8
  burst_window_ms: 500
throttle:
  baseline_rps: 1000
  burst_limit_rps: 300
```
tony: Staging rollout: enable toggle on canary nodes, run 4h soak, then promote to 30% traffic if stable. Target date: 2024-07-02.
lei: Dashboard snippets: add these queries + a sparkline heatmap for request interarrival time. Alert prototype (draft): ```sql
WHEN p99_99(latency_ms) > 220 FOR 10m
AND sum(rate(requests, 1m)) > 2000
THEN page eng-oncall, escalate to eng-platform after 15m
```
sara: Decision from sync: keep SLOs unchanged for now (throughput SLO p95 > 500 req/s), but introduce a temporary 'burst sensitivity' monitoring bucket and a soft SLA note for affected customers. If error budget runway <= 3d, trigger emergency mitigation and exec-notify.
lei: Timeline: dashboards + alert tweaks by Wed EOD. I will add a daily digest email for error-budget runway starting tomorrow.
tony: I'll open PR for toggle + throttle: https://go/redwood/pr/4992 (wip). Will tag @lei @sara for review.
rob: Draft comms: https://go/redwood/drafts/sla-note-07 (shared). Prefer to wait until we see canary results then send a short transparent update.
ops-bot: Followup task created: https://go/redwood/incidents/INC-2024-322  check-ins set for 2024-07-03 09:00 UTC.
sara: Also request: add a synthetic 'bursty-sim' to the CI stress tests to validate these changes (simulate 2000rps 10s spikes). @lei can you add?
lei: Yep, I'll add 'bursty-sim' to nightly stress and include a scheduler to run during low-traffic windows.
tony: If canary reduces p99.99 by >30% during synthetic bursts, we'll graduate change. Otherwise rollback and iterate.
sara: Good. I'll update the postmortem with owners, dates, and link all PRs. Please add any other tasks to the incident doc. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here. :wave:
